The '''Chiss Poachers' Base''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] owned by the [[Chiss Poachers]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Chiss' vast financial holdings kept their supply lines running smoothly, and their access to numerous independent [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] keep their fighting vessels on constant patrol.<ref name="SWG:CPB" />

Several large [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] floated near the station.
